findings.original_issue: Recovery-fixture readback check was over-indented, and failed_responses initialization/loop was nested in refusal accounting before use outside that scope.

findings.original_issue: accepted=false plus unchanged state could falsely pass a retry control: the first impulse arrests velocity, so erroneous replay could emit no impulse and fail again at the injected readback.
findings.correction: Retry requires exact DuplicateOrOldContact outcome, failed=false, unchanged actual RID state and unchanged readback-seam call count.
findings.status: corrected and reread in hash-bound source
